verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Kong Gateway's source is hosted and readable on a public GitHub repo (kong-gh-1 through kong-gh-19), and Insomnia is explicitly documented as 'open source' (kong-docs-6), supporting that at least part of the Kong ecosystem is openly licensed. However, no citation explicitly states the license terms (e.g., Apache 2.0) for Kong Gateway itself, and other components like Konnect/AI Gateway are SaaS and not claimed to be open-source at all. Missing for 10: explicit license text/name for Kong Gateway's source, clarity on which components (Konnect, AI Gateway, decK) are open vs proprietary.
